deadline.value: No deadline: enrolment for doctoral studies is possible at any time once a professor agrees to supervise you.
deadline.quote: Enrolment for doctoral studies is possible at any time.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You need a thesis supervisor; contact a professor or research group at one of the six D-USYS institutes.
supervisor.quote: To be admitted, you will need a supervisor for your thesis. Please contact a professor or research group at one of our six institutes.

funding.value: Apart from a few exceptions, ETH doctoral students are employed (salaried) as scientific assistants.
funding.quote: Apart from a few exceptional cases, all doctoral students at ETH Zurich are employed as scientific assistants.

entry_route.value: Open to graduates with a university diploma or Master's degree.
entry_route.quote: The application for doctoral studies is open to all university graduates with a university diploma or Master's degree.
